schema:
CREATE TABLE "Departments" ("dept_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "dept_name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "Employees" ("emp_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "dept_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "emp_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "bonus" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("dept_id") REFERENCES "Departments" ("dept_id"));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT d.dept_name, e.bonus FROM Departments AS d JOIN Employees AS e USING (dept_id) ORDER BY e.bonus DESC NULLS LAST, d.dept_name ASC

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant uses NULLS FIRST instead of NULLS LAST on a query with JOIN ... USING (...)
